audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 reads Skill and two-plus items reads Sion. The mirror audit (illaoi__sion) deliberately set Level 6 to Illaoi, and the packet gives Skill at two-plus items.
audit.why: spikes[1] and mid both describe Level 6 as the stage where Test of Spirit forces you to disengage with R — that is not an even row. whys[6] argues you must split rather than fight, which is not a Sion-won row either. Both layers agreed with each other but not with the text or the sources.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Illaoi (mirror), two-plus items to Skill (packet), in both layers with ratings following.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and whys[4] both frame Level 6 as Sion's window ('your panic button'), and phases[6].why claims the side lane at full power on a row that is not won.
audit.why: Leap of Faith spawns a tentacle for every champion it hits, so her 6 scales with bodies while yours does not. Sion's R at 6 is an exit from the vessel, not an entry into her field.
audit.corrected: Both whys rewritten around leaving the vessel zone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid block names 'the Harbinger of the Depths passive stacks she needs to drown you'. Harbinger of the Depths is not an Illaoi ability. Her passive is Prophet of an Elder God, and it heals rather than stacking. Separately, Harsh Lesson (W) — a 4-second dash and auto-attack reset that makes every nearby tentacle swing at you — is absent from all eighteen fields, and Test of Spirit's cooldown is never given.
audit.why: This is the exact class of error the calibration list warns about: a plausible-sounding name from another champion's kit, presented as a mechanic to play around. Harsh Lesson is her actual engage and her actual damage multiplier, and at 4s it is the reason 'fight away from tentacles' is the whole matchup. Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12.
audit.corrected: Prophet of an Elder God's healing replaces the fabricated name in mid; Harsh Lesson's 4s leap written into wants.foe[1]; Test of Spirit's 16s into whys[3]; anti-heal into wants.you[1].

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are the flattest stretch — her tentacles accumulate and her passive sustain keeps her healthy, while your charged Q is readable enough that she can pre-position away from choke points. Avoid charging Q in the middle of a tentacle cluster or you eat two slams during the channel. At level 6 you gain Unstoppable Onslaught as an escape valve: if she lands E and calls tentacles on your vessel, R away toward your tower, wait for the vessel to despawn, then R back in. Never sit inside her vessel zone trading — you are handing her the Harbinger of the Depths passive stacks she needs to drown you.

notes: The fabricated ability name in mid — 'Harbinger of the Depths' — is Nautilus's passive, not Illaoi's, and it was live on the page as something to play around. Worth grepping the repo for it on other pages. Illaoi's R carries an 'untargetable' derived flag that Riot's text does not support (the text only describes damage and tentacle spawning); treated as a tooltip-parsing misfire and not asserted anywhere. The mirror deliberately placed Level 6 with Illaoi and first item with Sion, which inverts packet.levelChart for those two rows; I followed the mirror on row 4 because spikes[1] and mid independently support it, and followed the packet on row 6 where the mirror said nothing. Full-layer mojibake em dashes copied exactly in 'before', plain hyphens in 'after'.
